svg.title: A report builder: count, sum or average tickets, grouped by any property or field — SoftTrack web design mockup (#328)
svg.desc: A report is four choices picked from lists: which tickets, a measure, what to group by and an optional second grouping. It is computed in the database, draws as bars, stacked bars or a table, shows None as a group, is honest when a ticket counts in two groups, and every number opens the tickets behind it.
svg.text: A report builder: count, sum or average tickets, grouped by any property or field
